examples.text: Die Nachbarin erwies sich als sehr mitteilsam, so dass ich nach zehn Minuten schon wusste, wann sie ihren Mann kennengelernt hat und dass sie fünf Kinder und drei Katzen hat.

examples.text: One of his attendants had found no little favour in the eyes of Alice, who expressed her suspicions that her mistress had some secret correspondence, for two reasons; first, to satisfy a naturally communicative temper—all common people are communicative: and secondly, in hopes of gaining such assistance as might ultimately gratify her own curiosity, now most uncomfortably excited.
